deadline.value: International early applications (complete review) by January 15, 2027; final deadline March 1, 2027 (documents by March 15). Year inferred.
deadline.quote: Early Applications (complete application review) - January 15 | Final Application Deadline – March 1 (Final Documentation Submission Deadline – March 15)

gre_general.value: GRE is officially optional, but applicants from outside Canada are expected to send scores; 600 verbal, 750 quantitative and 5.5 analytical earn special consideration.
gre_general.quote: Optional: Special consideration will be given to those with GRE scores of at least 600 verbal, 750 quantitative, and 720 analytical (5.5 in the new format). Applicants from outside Canada are expected to apply with GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You can apply without one, but admission depends on securing a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Applicants may submit an application; however, admission is contingent upon securing a supervisor.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student is guaranteed at least CAD 33,205 a year (international; CAD 31,426 domestic) for the first four years, if progress stays satisfactory.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students beginning their program on or after January 1, 2026, are guaranteed a minimum funding package of $31,426 for domestic students and $33,205 for international students. | These annual amounts are guaranteed for the first four years of a PhD program

entry_route.value: A thesis-based MSc is required; exceptional students with a four-year honours BSc (3.70 GPA) and research ability may apply.
entry_route.quote: A thesis-based MSc., or equivalent from a recognized institution.

also.quote: For exceptional students applying with a Bachelor of Science degree, a four-year Honours degree or its equivalent from a recognized institution with a minimum GPA of 3.70 and demonstrated research ability consistent with graduate level expectations.

toefl_min.value: Faculty of Science programs need TOEFL iBT 97 with 23 in each section (5.0 with 5.0 in each section on the new scale for tests on or after January 21, 2026).
toefl_min.quote: Graduate programs in the Faculty of Science require higher minimum scores than those specified by the Faculty of Graduate Studies. | TOEFL iBT (tests taken before January 21, 2026): 97 (minimum 23 in each section) | TOEFL iBT (tests taken on or after January 21, 2026): 5.0 (minimum 5.0 in each section)

ielts_min.value: Faculty of Science programs need IELTS Academic 7.0 with at least 6.5 in each section.
